bfruntime_read_check.reason: Deliberately skipped. Program identity is already established from the switchd log, which is a zero-risk file read. Opening even a read-only bfrt/gRPC client against a live bf_switchd is a non-zero perturbation of a running experiment. No conclusion depends on it.

loaded_binary_identity.question: Is the loaded tofino.bin the one produced by the switch-side 9.13.2 build of source sha fb3b10da...?
evidence: that file's mtime == ctime == 2026-07-25T21:41:41Z, equal to the switch build's manifest build_date, so it is the build's own output rather than a later copy (a copy would carry a later ctime)
the file was last modified 7 min 34 s BEFORE bf_switchd started at 21:49:15Z and has not been touched since, re-verified at 2026-07-26T00:26Z
therefore the bytes hashed in this audit (180e44aa...) are the bytes bf_switchd read at load
loaded_binary_identity.caveat: mtime/ctime are forgeable by a privileged user. No evidence of tampering; the three independent timestamps (build_date in manifest, file mtime, file ctime) corroborate each other.

contradiction_resolution.the_contradiction: Source header line 8 says '(Tofino 1, TNA, bf-p4c 9.13.1, compile-only, never loaded)' while the report claims that source sha was compiled AND loaded.
contradiction_resolution.resolution: The report is correct; the header comment is stale and wrong.
evidence: The identical string 'compile-only, never loaded' appears in the compile-only stage_reclamation lineage this program derives from: research/stage_reclamation/variants/p12_combined/p12_combined.p4:4, p14_fcsfix/p14_fcsfix.p4:4, p5_parser_padcode/p5_parser_padcode.p4:26, p4_size_only/p4_size_only.p4:33, p6_egress_pad/p6_egress_pad.p4:40, p6_egress_pad/p6c_true_trailer.p4:60, p12_combined/probe_parser_init/p12_probe_noinit.p4:4 - all genuinely compile-only.

The header block was copied wholesale from the predecessor research/timing_final/p4/dnp3_timing_normalizer.p4 (identical line 8) and never revised: line 2 of the INLINE file still names 'dnp3_timing_normalizer.p4', the predecessor's filename.

Hard artifacts say loaded: switch-side 9.13.2 build of that exact sha, a conf pointing at its output, a bf_switchd log printing 'p4_name: dnp3_timing_normalizer_inline' and 'dev_id 0 initialized' in ASIC mode, and one live process still running it.
contradiction_resolution.also_stale_on_the_same_line: 'bf-p4c 9.13.1' alone understates the build story: the program was compiled with bf-p4c 9.13.1 off-switch AND 9.13.2 on-switch, and it is the 9.13.2 build that reached silicon.
contradiction_resolution.recommended_corrected_header: (Tofino 1, TNA. Compiled with bf-p4c 9.13.1 off-switch and 9.13.2 on the switch - same MAU footprint both ways: 10 of 12 stages, 60 logical tables, 55 SRAM blocks. LOADED ON SILICON: bf_switchd on Tofino-1, conf /home/decps/timing_inline/tn_inline_abs.conf, 2026-07-25 21:49:15 UTC. Source sha256 fb3b10dad575bed4a5da9943530ac3776e3e7d1243c3e986f092711b0d09e94c.)
contradiction_resolution.also_fix_line_2: line 2 should name dnp3_timing_normalizer_inline.p4, not dnp3_timing_normalizer.p4
contradiction_resolution.edit_warning: Editing the file changes its sha256, which is pinned as P4_SRC_SHA256 in research/timing_final/config/lab.env.inline and quoted in the report's Provenance section, and which currently matches the staged copy on the switch. Any edit must be followed by re-pinning that value, deciding whether to re-stage the switch copy, and updating the report text; otherwise this audit's five-way hash match is broken by the act of correcting the comment.
